items.title: Send back signed consent to the rent increase
items.quote: Ihre Antwort benötigen wir bis Ende Januar 2027.
items.computation: The letter was personally delivered by the cooperative's messenger (Einwurf in den Briefkasten) on 18.11.2026 at 8:50, so Zugang (actual receipt) is 18.11.2026 itself - no 3/4-day fiction needed since actual delivery day is stated. Under § 558b Abs. 2 BGB, consent to a § 558 rent increase demand must be declared by the end of the second calendar month following receipt. First calendar month after receipt = December 2026; second calendar month = January 2027 → period ends 31.01.2027 (Ablauf des zweiten Kalendermonats). 31.01.2027 is a Sunday. Since this is a declaration that must reach the landlord, § 193 BGB shifts the end of the period to the next working day: Monday 01.02.2027. This matches the letter's own wording 'bis Ende Januar 2027' read as the statutory deadline, extended by one day for the weekend.

items.title: New rent (434,50 €) takes effect, if consent is given
items.quote: das Nutzungsentgelt ab dem 01.02.2027 um 10 % auf 434,50 € zu erhöhen
items.computation: The letter states the increase is to take effect from a fixed calendar date given explicitly as 01.02.2027; this date is used as written and does not depend on any period calculation.

warnings: The letter itself says the reply is needed 'bis Ende Januar 2027' (31.01.2027), but that day is a Sunday; the statutory consent period under § 558b BGB combined with § 193 BGB actually runs through Monday 01.02.2027 - sending the signed consent on 01.02.2027 should still be timely, but replying by 31.01.2027 as literally stated is the safer course.

This is a request for the tenant's voluntary consent to a rent increase under § 558 BGB, not an administrative decision; if consent is withheld or not given by the deadline, the cooperative would need to sue for consent (Zustimmungsklage) rather than the tenant having to object - the person is not obliged to agree, only to respond.
